title: Get Up Stand Up Paddleboard Lesson in Tahoe City
includes: Paddleboard, Personal Flotation Device, and Paddle.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Learn the basics of how to Stand Up Paddle Board on our Get Up Stand Up Tour! The waters are calmest in the morning, get out before the hustle and bustle of Lake Tahoe watercrafts hit the water, learn the fundamentals of the paddle stroke and balance, and enjoy a morning of instruction from one of our seasoned guides.
